**Configuration:**

### **Dependencies**

**Dev:** Vite 5.4, TypeScript 5.8, ESLint, Vitest, Playwright, Lovable tagger

### **Mobile Responsiveness**
- Sidebar collapses to icon-only on mobile (< 768px)
- `useIsMobile()` hook for responsive logic
- All components tested at mobile breakpoint
- Responsive navigation items and layout

   - Page screenshot in browser frame mockup

   - Each finding: title, severity, current state, recommendation, AI suggestion
   - Blurred/locked premium content with "Upgrade to Pro" overlay

4. **Pricing Page** - 3-tier pricing:

5. **Public Landing Page** - Marketing page (no sidebar):

   - Hero: "Your Website Is Losing Visitors. We'll Tell You Exactly Why."
   - Big URL input field inline
   - Social proof, How It Works (3 steps), Features grid (6 cards)
   - Score preview mockup section
   - Final CTA dark section + Footer

6. **Auth Pages** - Login/Signup:
   - Split screen: form left, testimonial right (dark panel)

7. **My Reports Page** - Card grid of past scans:

   - Each card: favicon + URL, score ring, stats, date
   - Empty state

8. **Settings Page** - Tabbed layout:
   - Profile, Billing, Notifications, API Keys tabs

   - Billing: current plan, usage bar, payment method, history
   - Notifications: toggle switches

   - Cards for Hotjar, Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, Google Search Console

- Dark sidebar + light content area (already in place)
- Color system: Background #FAFBFC, Primary #6366F1 (indigo), Success green, Warning amber, Error red
- Inter font throughout, KPI numbers 48px bold
- Cards: white bg, 1px slate-200 border, rounded-xl, NO heavy shadows

I have a complete picture of the codebase. Here is the detailed implementation plan.

---

## CROBOT Frontend Implementation Plan

### Codebase Assessment

**What exists today:**
- React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind + shadcn/ui shell
- 49 shadcn/ui components installed at `src/components/ui/`
- `AppLayout` (sidebar + topbar + outlet), `AppSidebar`, `TopBar`, `NavLink` components
- 6 placeholder pages (Dashboard, Scan, Reports, Pricing, Settings, Integrations) -- all just title + "coming soon"
- Design tokens in CSS variables: indigo primary (`239 84% 67%`), slate palette, Inter font, sidebar dark theme
- `@` path alias configured in vite and tsconfig
- React Query, React Hook Form, Zod, Recharts, Lucide icons, date-fns all in `package.json`
- No custom hooks beyond `use-mobile` and `use-toast`
- No data layer, no mock data, no auth, no landing page

**Key architectural conventions to follow:**
- Pages are default exports in `src/pages/`
- Layout components in `src/components/`
- UI primitives in `src/components/ui/`
- Utility `cn()` in `src/lib/utils.ts`
- Heading style: `text-[28px] font-bold text-foreground`
- Card pattern: `<Card>` with `<CardContent>`, white bg, border

---

### Phase 0: Foundation Layer (Do This First)

Before building any pages, establish the shared infrastructure that every page will depend on.

#### 0A. File Structure Expansion

Create these new directories:

```
src/
  components/
    ui/           (existing -- 49 shadcn components)
    shared/       (new -- reusable CROBOT-specific components)
    landing/      (new -- landing page sections)
  pages/          (existing -- expand)
  lib/
    utils.ts      (existing)
    mock-data.ts  (new -- all mock/seed data)
    constants.ts  (new -- CRO pillars, score thresholds, plan tiers)
    score-utils.ts (new -- score color logic, formatting)
  hooks/
    use-mobile.tsx (existing)
    use-toast.ts   (existing)
  types/
    index.ts      (new -- all TypeScript interfaces)
```

#### 0B. Type Definitions -- `src/types/index.ts`

Define all core interfaces upfront so every page can import them:

```typescript
// User / Auth
interface UserProfile {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  full_name: string;
  company_name: string | null;
  website_url: string | null;
  avatar_url: string | null;
  plan: "free" | "pro" | "agency";
  scans_used: number;
  scan_limit: number;
}

// Scans
type ScanStatus = "pending" | "running" | "completed" | "failed";
type PageType = "homepage" | "landing" | "product" | "checkout" | "blog" | "other";

interface Scan {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  url: string;
  page_type: PageType;
  status: ScanStatus;
  overall_score: number | null;
  issues_found: number;
  screenshot_url: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  completed_at: string | null;
}

// CRO Pillars
type CroPillar =
  | "value_proposition"
  | "visual_hierarchy"
  | "cta_optimization"
  | "trust_signals"
  | "page_speed"
  | "mobile_experience"
  | "content_clarity";

type Severity = "critical" | "warning" | "info";

interface Finding {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  severity: Severity;
  current_state: string;
  recommendation: string;
  ai_suggestion: string;
  is_premium: boolean;
}

interface PillarResult {
  id: string;
  scan_id: string;
  pillar: CroPillar;
  score: number;
  findings: Finding[];
}

// Pricing
interface PricingTier {
  name: string;
  price_monthly: number;
  price_annual: number;
  features: { text: string; included: boolean }[];
  highlighted: boolean;
  cta_text: string;
}
```

#### 0C. Constants -- `src/lib/constants.ts`

Centralize all magic values:

- `CRO_PILLARS` array with `key`, `label`, `icon` (Lucide icon name), `description`
- `SCORE_THRESHOLDS`: `{ poor: 40, average: 70 }` (below 40 = red, 40-70 = amber, 70+ = green)
- `PRICING_TIERS`: the 3-tier pricing data
- `SCAN_STEPS`: the 7 analysis steps with labels for the progress timeline
- `PLAN_LIMITS`: `{ free: 3, pro: 50, agency: 500 }`

#### 0D. Score Utilities -- `src/lib/score-utils.ts`

```typescript
export function getScoreColor(score: number): string // returns tailwind class
export function getScoreLabel(score: number): string  // "Poor" | "Average" | "Good" | "Excellent"
export function getSeverityColor(severity: Severity): string
export function formatScore(score: number): string
```

#### 0E. Mock Data -- `src/lib/mock-data.ts`

Create realistic mock data for development:

- `MOCK_USER`: a UserProfile on the "free" plan
- `MOCK_SCANS`: 8-10 scans with varying scores, statuses, dates
- `MOCK_SCAN_RESULTS`: full pillar results for 2-3 completed scans with 3-5 findings each
- `MOCK_DASHBOARD_STATS`: aggregated KPIs derived from MOCK_SCANS

This is critical -- every page consumes this data, so building it first unblocks all parallel work.

#### 0F. Shared Components -- `src/components/shared/`

These are reused across 3+ pages:

| Component | File | Used By | Built From |
|-----------|------|---------|------------|
| `ScoreRing` | `ScoreRing.tsx` | Dashboard, Reports, AuditReport | SVG circle + text, score-color logic |
| `KpiCard` | `KpiCard.tsx` | Dashboard | `Card` + 48px bold number + label + trend arrow |
| `SeverityBadge` | `SeverityBadge.tsx` | AuditReport, Reports | `Badge` with severity-based colors |
| `PillarProgressBar` | `PillarProgressBar.tsx` | AuditReport | `Progress` with pillar label + score |
| `UrlInput` | `UrlInput.tsx` | Dashboard, Scan, Landing | `Input` (48px height) + `Button` + `Select` for page type |
| `EmptyState` | `EmptyState.tsx` | Reports, Dashboard | Icon + title + description + CTA button |
| `PremiumLock` | `PremiumLock.tsx` | AuditReport | Blurred overlay div + lock icon + "Upgrade" CTA |
| `PageHeader` | `PageHeader.tsx` | All app pages | Title (28px bold) + description + optional action button |

**ScoreRing** is the most critical shared component. It is an SVG-based circular progress indicator that:
- Takes `score: number` and `size: number` props
- Renders a background circle (slate-200) and a foreground arc
- Colors the arc using `getScoreColor(score)` -- red/amber/green
- Displays the score number centered in the ring, bold
- Animates on mount with a CSS transition on `stroke-dashoffset`

**KpiCard** structure:
- White card, rounded-xl, 1px border-slate-200
- Top: icon in colored circle + label in muted-foreground
- Middle: 48px font-bold number
- Bottom: trend indicator (green up arrow or red down arrow + percentage)

**PremiumLock** overlay:
- Absolutely positioned over content
- `backdrop-blur-md` + semi-transparent white overlay
- Lock icon from Lucide + "Unlock with Pro" text + `Button` linking to `/pricing`
- This is the key monetization UX element

---

### Phase 1: Dashboard Page

**File:** `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` (replace existing placeholder)

**shadcn/ui components used:** `Card`, `CardContent`, `CardHeader`, `CardTitle`, `Button`, `Input`, `Select`, `Table`, `TableHeader`, `TableRow`, `TableHead`, `TableBody`, `TableCell`, `Badge`, `Skeleton`

**Custom components used:** `KpiCard`, `ScoreRing`, `UrlInput`, `PageHeader`

**Layout structure (top to bottom):**

1. **PageHeader** -- "Welcome back, {name}!" with subtitle "Here's your CRO performance overview."

2. **KPI Cards Row** -- 4 cards in a `grid grid-cols-4 gap-4`:
   - Total Scans (ScanLine icon, primary bg)
   - Avg CRO Score (Target icon, score-colored)
   - Issues Found (AlertTriangle icon, warning bg)
   - Est. Revenue Impact (DollarSign icon, success bg)
   - Each uses `KpiCard` shared component

3. **Two-column grid** (`grid grid-cols-3 gap-6`):
   - **Left (col-span-2): Recent Scans Table**
     - Card with "Recent Scans" header + "View All" link to `/reports`
     - `Table` with columns: URL (with favicon), Score (ScoreRing, small 36px), Issues, Status (Badge), Date
     - 5 most recent scans from mock data
     - Each row clickable, links to `/reports/:id`
   - **Right (col-span-1): Quick Scan Card**
     - Card with `UrlInput` component
     - "Scan Now" primary button
     - Below: Score Distribution mini bar chart using Recharts `BarChart`
     - Shows distribution of scan scores in buckets (0-20, 20-40, etc.)

**Recharts usage for Score Distribution:**
- `BarChart` with `Bar` component
- X-axis: score ranges, Y-axis: count
- Bars colored by score range (red/amber/green)
- Use the `ChartContainer` from `src/components/ui/chart.tsx`

**Verification:** Page renders with all 4 KPI cards showing mock numbers, table shows 5 rows, chart renders bars, Quick Scan input is functional (navigates to `/scan?url=...` on submit).

---

### Phase 2: New Scan Page

**File:** `src/pages/Scan.tsx` (replace existing placeholder)

**New components:**
- `src/components/shared/ScanProgressTimeline.tsx`

**shadcn/ui components:** `Card`, `CardContent`, `Input`, `Button`, `Select`, `SelectTrigger`, `SelectContent`, `SelectItem`, `Progress`, `Badge`

**Two states managed by local state (`useState`):**

**State A: URL Input Form**
- PageHeader: "New Scan" + "Analyze any page for CRO opportunities"
- Large centered card (max-w-2xl mx-auto)
- `UrlInput` (48px height, full width) with placeholder "https://example.com"
- `Select` dropdown for page type (Homepage, Landing Page, Product Page, Checkout, Blog, Other)
- "Start Analysis" primary button (lg size, full width below input)
- Below form: "What we analyze" section -- 7 small cards in a grid showing the CRO pillars with icons and one-line descriptions
- Usage indicator: "2 of 3 free scans used" with a thin progress bar (for free plan urgency)

**State B: Analysis Progress View** (shown after clicking "Start Analysis")
- Triggered by form submission, uses `setTimeout` chain to simulate progress
- Card with animated content:
  - URL being scanned shown at top in a "browser frame" mock (rounded-t-lg gray bar with dots + URL text)
  - `ScanProgressTimeline` component: vertical timeline with 7 steps:
    1. Fetching page content
    2. Analyzing value proposition
    3. Evaluating visual hierarchy
    4. Checking CTA optimization
    5. Assessing trust signals
    6. Measuring page performance
    7. Reviewing mobile experience
  - Each step: circle indicator (gray=pending, indigo=active with pulse animation, green=complete with checkmark), label, elapsed time
  - Overall `Progress` bar at top showing percentage
  - Steps complete one by one over ~8 seconds total (simulated with timeouts)
  - On completion: auto-redirect to `/reports/:newScanId` after 1-second delay

**ScanProgressTimeline component** (`src/components/shared/ScanProgressTimeline.tsx`):
- Props: `currentStep: number`, `steps: { label: string; duration: string }[]`
- Renders vertical line with step circles
- Uses `tailwindcss-animate` for the pulse on active step
- Completed steps get green checkmark icon + line turns green

**Verification:** Form validates URL format (Zod schema). Submitting triggers animated progress. All 7 steps animate in sequence. Redirects to report page on completion.

---

### Phase 3: Audit Report Page (The "Money Page")

This is the most complex page and the core value delivery. Build it as a dedicated route.

**File:** `src/pages/AuditReport.tsx` (new file)  
**Route:** Add `/reports/:id` to point to `AuditReport` instead of `Reports`

**New components:**
- `src/components/shared/BrowserFrame.tsx` -- screenshot in a fake browser chrome
- `src/components/shared/FindingCard.tsx` -- individual audit finding
- `src/components/shared/PillarScoreCard.tsx` -- pillar with score bar + findings count

**shadcn/ui components:** `Card`, `Tabs`, `TabsList`, `TabsTrigger`, `TabsContent`, `Badge`, `Button`, `Progress`, `Separator`, `Tooltip`, `ScrollArea`, `Skeleton`, `Dialog`

**Page layout (single column, max-w-[1200px]):**

1. **Report Header Row**
   - Left: URL (as link), page type badge, scan date, status badge
   - Right: 3 action buttons -- "Download PDF" (outline), "Share Report" (outline), "Re-scan" (primary)
   - Download and Share show a dialog saying "Available on Pro" for free users

2. **Score Overview Section** (`grid grid-cols-3 gap-6`)
   - **Left (col-span-1): Giant ScoreRing** (200px diameter)
     - Score number 64px bold centered
     - Label below: "CRO Score" + score category text
     - Ring color reflects score
   - **Right (col-span-2): Pillar Scores Grid**
     - 7 `PillarScoreCard` components in a vertical stack
     - Each: pillar icon + name, horizontal `Progress` bar (colored by score), score number right-aligned
     - Sorted by score ascending (worst first -- draws attention to problems)

3. **Page Screenshot Section**
   - `BrowserFrame` component: rounded-lg container with gray top bar (3 dots + URL), inside shows a placeholder screenshot image (gray gradient placeholder for now)
   - Overlaid: floating badges pointing to issues (absolute positioned colored dots with tooltips)
   - This section is visually impressive even with a placeholder image

4. **Detailed Findings Tabs**
   - `Tabs` component with 7 tabs (one per pillar)
   - Each tab label: pillar name + issue count badge
   - Tab content: list of `FindingCard` components

   **FindingCard** structure:
   - Card with left colored border (red=critical, amber=warning, blue=info)
   - Header row: `SeverityBadge` + finding title (font-semibold)
   - "Current State" section: gray bg box with the problem description
   - "Recommendation" section: the fix
   - "AI Suggestion" section (expandable collapsible): detailed AI-generated advice
   - For `is_premium: true` findings: the entire card is wrapped in `PremiumLock` overlay (blurred content + upgrade CTA)
   - This is the key monetization trigger -- show 2-3 findings unlocked, blur the rest

5. **Bottom CTA Bar** (sticky or at bottom)
   - "Unlock all findings and AI suggestions" + "Upgrade to Pro" button
   - Show count: "3 of 12 findings locked"
   - Only visible for free plan users

**BrowserFrame** component:
- Rounded-xl container
- Top bar: `h-8 bg-slate-100 rounded-t-xl` with 3 small colored circles (red/yellow/green, 8px each) and URL text centered
- Content area: children slot for screenshot/placeholder

**Verification:** Score ring animates on load. All 7 pillar bars render. Tabs switch between pillars. Premium findings are blurred with upgrade overlay. Action buttons are interactive.

---

### Phase 4: Pricing Page

**File:** `src/pages/Pricing.tsx` (replace placeholder)

**shadcn/ui components:** `Card`, `CardContent`, `CardHeader`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `Button`, `Badge`, `Switch`, `Separator`, `Accordion`, `AccordionItem`, `AccordionTrigger`, `AccordionContent`

**Layout:**

1. **Header** (centered text)

- `fade-in`: opacity 0 to 1, translateY(8px) to 0 (for page transitions)
- `scale-in`: scale 0.95 to 1 + fade (for cards appearing)
- `slide-up`: translateY(20px) to 0 (for staggered list items)
- `pulse-ring`: for the scan progress active step indicator
- `count-up`: for KPI numbers (use a custom hook `useCountUp` that animates from 0 to target)

Add a `useCountUp` hook in `src/hooks/use-count-up.ts`:
- Takes target number and duration
- Returns animated current value using `requestAnimationFrame`
- Used by `KpiCard` for the 48px numbers

#### 10B. Page Transition Wrapper

Create `src/components/shared/PageTransition.tsx`:
- Wraps page content with `animate-fade-in` class
- Provides staggered animation for child elements using CSS `animation-delay`

#### 10C. Responsive Breakpoints

All grid layouts need responsive behavior:
- KPI cards: `grid-cols-4` -> `grid-cols-2` on tablet -> `grid-cols-1` on mobile
- Report cards: `grid-cols-3` -> `grid-cols-2` -> `grid-cols-1`
- Pricing cards: `grid-cols-3` -> stacked on mobile (Pro card first)
- Landing page: all sections stack vertically on mobile
- Sidebar: already has collapsible behavior via shadcn sidebar

#### 10D. Loading States

Every page should have a skeleton loading state:
- Dashboard: 4 skeleton KPI cards + skeleton table rows
- Reports: skeleton card grid
- Audit Report: skeleton score ring + skeleton pillar bars
- Use existing `Skeleton` component from shadcn

#### 10E. Micro-interactions

- Buttons: slight scale on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`) + transition
- Cards: `hover:border-primary/30 transition-colors duration-200`
- Score rings: animate `stroke-dashoffset` on mount (CSS transition 1s ease-out)
- Tab transitions: fade content on switch
- Toast notifications: use Sonner for scan complete, errors, etc.

---

### Implementation Sequence and Dependencies

```
Phase 0 (Foundation)     ← MUST be first, everything depends on it
  ├── 0B Types
  ├── 0C Constants  
  ├── 0D Score Utils
  ├── 0E Mock Data (depends on 0B)
  └── 0F Shared Components (depends on 0D, 0E)

Phase 1 (Dashboard)      ← depends on Phase 0
Phase 2 (New Scan)       ← depends on Phase 0
Phase 3 (Audit Report)   ← depends on Phase 0, most complex
Phase 4 (Pricing)        ← depends on Phase 0, standalone
Phase 5 (Landing)        ← depends on Phase 0, standalone
Phase 6 (My Reports)     ← depends on Phase 0
Phase 7 (Settings)       ← depends on Phase 0
Phase 8 (Integrations)   ← depends on Phase 0, simplest page

Phase 9 (Auth)           ← depends on all pages existing
Phase 10 (Polish)        ← last, after all pages functional
```

Phases 1-8 can be built in any order after Phase 0, but the priority order listed above reflects user-facing value: Dashboard and Scan are the core loop, Audit Report is the revenue page, Pricing converts users.

---

### Estimated New Files Created

| Directory | Files | Purpose |
|-----------|-------|---------|
| `src/types/` | 1 | `index.ts` |
| `src/lib/` | 3 | `constants.ts`, `mock-data.ts`, `score-utils.ts` |
| `src/hooks/` | 2 | `use-auth.ts`, `use-count-up.ts` |
| `src/components/shared/` | 11 | ScoreRing, KpiCard, SeverityBadge, PillarProgressBar, UrlInput, EmptyState, PremiumLock, PageHeader, ScanProgressTimeline, BrowserFrame, FindingCard, PillarScoreCard, PageTransition, AuthLayout, ProtectedRoute |
| `src/components/landing/` | 8 | HeroSection, SocialProof, HowItWorks, FeaturesGrid, ScorePreview, LandingNav, LandingFooter, FinalCta |
| `src/pages/` | 3 new | `Landing.tsx`, `AuditReport.tsx`, `Login.tsx`, `Signup.tsx` |
| `src/pages/` | 6 replaced | Dashboard, Scan, Reports, Pricing, Settings, Integrations |

**Total: ~34 new/replaced files**, plus modifications to `App.tsx` (routing) and `index.css` (animations).

---

### Potential Challenges

1. **ScoreRing SVG math** -- The circular progress requires calculating `stroke-dasharray` and `stroke-dashoffset` from the score percentage. This is well-documented but fiddly. Reference: circumference = `2 * PI * radius`, offset = `circumference * (1 - score/100)`.

2. **Scan progress simulation** -- The 7-step animation needs careful `setTimeout` orchestration. Consider using a `useReducer` with a state machine (pending/active/complete per step) rather than managing 7 boolean states.

3. **Premium lock blur** -- The `backdrop-blur` overlay needs to be positioned correctly over variable-height content. Use `relative` on the parent and `absolute inset-0` on the overlay. Test with different content lengths.

4. **Landing page outside AppLayout** -- The route structure needs to cleanly separate public routes (Landing, Login, Signup) from authenticated routes (wrapped in AppLayout). The current `App.tsx` nests everything under AppLayout, which must be restructured.

5. **Mock data realism** -- The mock data needs to be convincing enough for demos. Use real-looking URLs (example.com/pricing, store.example.com/checkout), varied scores, and realistic finding text about CRO issues.

6. **Recharts responsive sizing** -- Recharts charts need a `ResponsiveContainer` wrapper to resize properly. The `ChartContainer` from shadcn's chart.tsx handles this, so use it consistently.

---

### Critical Files for Implementation

- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/CROBOT/src/App.tsx` -- routing restructure is the backbone; all new pages and the public/private route split originate here
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/CROBOT/src/index.css` -- design tokens and animation keyframes; the visual foundation for every component
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/CROBOT/src/components/AppLayout.tsx` -- the authenticated shell that wraps all app pages; must be adapted for ProtectedRoute
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/CROBOT/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` -- the first page users see after login; anchors the KPI/data-first design language
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/CROBOT/tailwind.config.ts` -- animation keyframes, any extended colors or utilities needed for the premium feel

I have a complete picture of the codebase. Here is the detailed implementation plan.

---

## CROBOT Frontend Implementation Plan

### Codebase Assessment

**What exists today:**
- React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind + shadcn/ui shell
- 49 shadcn/ui components installed at `src/components/ui/`
- `AppLayout` (sidebar + topbar + outlet), `AppSidebar`, `TopBar`, `NavLink` components
- 6 placeholder pages (Dashboard, Scan, Reports, Pricing, Settings, Integrations) -- all just title + "coming soon"
- Design tokens in CSS variables: indigo primary (`239 84% 67%`), slate palette, Inter font, sidebar dark theme
- `@` path alias configured in vite and tsconfig
- React Query, React Hook Form, Zod, Recharts, Lucide icons, date-fns all in `package.json`
- No custom hooks beyond `use-mobile` and `use-toast`
- No data layer, no mock data, no auth, no landing page

**Key architectural conventions to follow:**
- Pages are default exports in `src/pages/`
- Layout components in `src/components/`
- UI primitives in `src/components/ui/`
- Utility `cn()` in `src/lib/utils.ts`
- Heading style: `text-[28px] font-bold text-foreground`
- Card pattern: `<Card>` with `<CardContent>`, white bg, border

---

### Phase 0: Foundation Layer (Do This First)

Before building any pages, establish the shared infrastructure that every page will depend on.

#### 0A. File Structure Expansion

Create these new directories:

```
src/
  components/
    ui/           (existing -- 49 shadcn components)
    shared/       (new -- reusable CROBOT-specific components)
    landing/      (new -- landing page sections)
  pages/          (existing -- expand)
  lib/
    utils.ts      (existing)
    mock-data.ts  (new -- all mock/seed data)
    constants.ts  (new -- CRO pillars, score thresholds, plan tiers)
    score-utils.ts (new -- score color logic, formatting)
  hooks/
    use-mobile.tsx (existing)
    use-toast.ts   (existing)
  types/
    index.ts      (new -- all TypeScript interfaces)
```

#### 0B. Type Definitions -- `src/types/index.ts`

Define all core interfaces upfront so every page can import them:

```typescript
// User / Auth
interface UserProfile {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  full_name: string;
  company_name: string | null;
  website_url: string | null;
  avatar_url: string | null;
  plan: "free" | "pro" | "agency";
  scans_used: number;
  scan_limit: number;
}

// Scans
type ScanStatus = "pending" | "running" | "completed" | "failed";
type PageType = "homepage" | "landing" | "product" | "checkout" | "blog" | "other";

interface Scan {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  url: string;
  page_type: PageType;
  status: ScanStatus;
  overall_score: number | null;
  issues_found: number;
  screenshot_url: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  completed_at: string | null;
}

// CRO Pillars
type CroPillar =
  | "value_proposition"
  | "visual_hierarchy"
  | "cta_optimization"
  | "trust_signals"
  | "page_speed"
  | "mobile_experience"
  | "content_clarity";

type Severity = "critical" | "warning" | "info";

interface Finding {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  severity: Severity;
  current_state: string;
  recommendation: string;
  ai_suggestion: string;
  is_premium: boolean;
}

interface PillarResult {
  id: string;
  scan_id: string;
  pillar: CroPillar;
  score: number;
  findings: Finding[];
}

// Pricing
interface PricingTier {
  name: string;
  price_monthly: number;
  price_annual: number;
  features: { text: string; included: boolean }[];
  highlighted: boolean;
  cta_text: string;
}
```

#### 0C. Constants -- `src/lib/constants.ts`

Centralize all magic values:

- `CRO_PILLARS` array with `key`, `label`, `icon` (Lucide icon name), `description`
- `SCORE_THRESHOLDS`: `{ poor: 40, average: 70 }` (below 40 = red, 40-70 = amber, 70+ = green)
- `PRICING_TIERS`: the 3-tier pricing data

### Potential Challenges

1. **ScoreRing SVG math** -- The circular progress requires calculating `stroke-dasharray` and `stroke-dashoffset` from the score percentage. This is well-documented but fiddly. Reference: circumference = `2 * PI * radius`, offset = `circumference * (1 - score/100)`.

2. **Scan progress simulation** -- The 7-step animation needs careful `setTimeout` orchestration. Consider using a `useReducer` with a state machine (pending/active/complete per step) rather than managing 7 boolean states.

# CROBOT — Production-Grade UI/UX Build Plan

## Context

CROBOT is an AI-powered CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) audit tool. Users paste a URL and get an instant analysis of what's hurting their conversions with AI-generated suggestions. The current codebase has only the app shell built (~15-20% complete) — a dark sidebar, top bar, and placeholder pages. We need to build out all pages to production-grade quality matching Hotjar/Linear/Vercel, applying marketing psychology (urgency, social proof, premium feel, blurred premium content as upgrade triggers).

**Stack:** React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui (49 components ready) + React Router v6 + Recharts + React Hook Form + Zod + Lucide Icons

---

## Phase 0: Foundation Layer (Build First — Everything Depends on This)

### 0A. New File Structure
```
src/
  types/index.ts           — TypeScript interfaces (Scan, Finding, PillarResult, etc.)
  lib/constants.ts         — CRO pillars, score thresholds, pricing tiers, scan steps
  lib/score-utils.ts       — getScoreColor(), getScoreLabel(), getSeverityColor()
  lib/mock-data.ts         — Realistic mock data for all pages
  hooks/use-count-up.ts    — Animated number counter for KPI cards
  hooks/use-auth.ts        — Mock auth context (React Context + localStorage)
  components/shared/       — Reusable CROBOT-specific components:
    ScoreRing.tsx           — SVG circular progress (score-colored, animated)
    KpiCard.tsx             — 48px bold number + label + trend indicator
    SeverityBadge.tsx       — Critical/Warning/Info colored badges
    PillarProgressBar.tsx   — Horizontal bar with pillar label + score
    UrlInput.tsx            — 48px tall URL input + page type select + CTA button
    EmptyState.tsx          — Icon + title + description + CTA
    PremiumLock.tsx         — Blurred overlay with lock icon + "Upgrade" CTA
    PageHeader.tsx          — Page title (28px bold) + description + action button
    ScanProgressTimeline.tsx — Vertical 7-step animated timeline
    BrowserFrame.tsx        — Fake browser chrome for screenshot display
    FindingCard.tsx         — Individual audit finding with severity + recommendation
    PageTransition.tsx      — Fade-in animation wrapper
    AuthLayout.tsx          — Split-screen layout for login/signup
    ProtectedRoute.tsx      — Auth check wrapper
  components/landing/      — Landing page section components (8 files)
```

### 0B. Key Types (`src/types/index.ts`)
- `UserProfile` (id, email, full_name, plan, scans_used, scan_limit)
- `Scan` (id, url, page_type, status, overall_score, issues_found, timestamps)
- `CroPillar` union type (7 pillars)
- `Finding` (title, severity, current_state, recommendation, ai_suggestion, is_premium)
- `PillarResult` (scan_id, pillar, score, findings[])
- `PricingTier` (name, prices, features, highlighted)

### 0C. Constants (`src/lib/constants.ts`)
- `CRO_PILLARS` — 7 pillars with key, label, icon, description
- `SCORE_THRESHOLDS` — { poor: 40, average: 70 }
- `PRICING_TIERS` — Free/Pro/Agency data
- `SCAN_STEPS` — 7 analysis step labels
- `PLAN_LIMITS` — { free: 3, pro: 50, agency: 500 }

### 0D. Score Utils (`src/lib/score-utils.ts`)
- `getScoreColor(score)` → red (<40), amber (40-70), green (70+)
- `getScoreLabel(score)` → "Poor" / "Needs Work" / "Good" / "Excellent"
- `getSeverityColor(severity)` → red/amber/blue classes

### 0E. Mock Data (`src/lib/mock-data.ts`)
- 8-10 realistic scans with varied scores (35-92)
- Full pillar results for 3 scans with 3-5 findings each
- Dashboard stats aggregated from mock scans

### 0F. Animations (add to `index.css` + `tailwind.config.ts`)
- `fade-in` — opacity + translateY
- `scale-in` — scale + fade for cards
- `slide-up` — staggered list items
- `pulse-ring` — scan progress active indicator

### 0G. Shared Components (see descriptions above)
Most critical: **ScoreRing** (SVG circle, animated stroke-dashoffset) and **PremiumLock** (backdrop-blur overlay, key monetization UX)

**Files to modify:** `src/index.css`, `tailwind.config.ts`

---

## Phase 1: Dashboard Page

**File:** `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` (replace existing)

**Layout (top to bottom):**
1. PageHeader — "Welcome back!" + subtitle
2. 4 KPI Cards (`grid-cols-4`): Total Scans, Avg CRO Score, Issues Found, Est. Revenue Impact — each with 48px bold number, trend arrow, colored icon
3. Two-column grid:
   - Left (2/3): Recent Scans table (URL + favicon, ScoreRing mini, issues count, status badge, date) — 5 rows
   - Right (1/3): Quick Scan card with UrlInput + Score Distribution bar chart (Recharts BarChart)

**shadcn components:** Card, Table, Badge, Button, Input, Select, Skeleton

---

## Phase 2: New Scan Page

**File:** `src/pages/Scan.tsx` (replace existing)

**Two states:**

**State A — URL Input Form:**
- Centered card (max-w-2xl), UrlInput (48px), page type dropdown, "Start Analysis" full-width button
- Below: 7 small pillar cards showing what gets analyzed
- Usage indicator: "2/3 free scans used" progress bar

**State B — Analysis Progress (after submit):**
- Browser frame mockup showing URL being scanned
- ScanProgressTimeline: 7 steps animating sequentially (~8 seconds total)
- Each step: pending (gray) → active (indigo pulse) → complete (green check)
- Overall Progress bar at top
- Auto-redirect to `/reports/:id` on completion

**shadcn components:** Card, Input, Button, Select, Progress, Badge

---

## Phase 3: Audit Report Page (The "Money Page")

**File:** `src/pages/AuditReport.tsx` (new)
**Route:** `/reports/:id` → AuditReport

**Layout:**
1. Report Header — URL + page type + date + status | Download PDF, Share, Re-scan buttons
2. Score Overview (`grid-cols-3`):
   - Left: Giant ScoreRing (200px, 64px number)
   - Right: 7 PillarProgressBars sorted worst-first
3. Page Screenshot — BrowserFrame with placeholder + floating issue badges
4. Detailed Findings — Tabs (7 tabs, one per pillar):
   - Each tab: list of FindingCards
   - FindingCard: colored left border, severity badge, current state, recommendation, AI suggestion
   - Premium findings: wrapped in PremiumLock (blurred + "Upgrade to Pro")
   - Show 2-3 unlocked, blur the rest → creates upgrade desire
5. Bottom CTA — "Unlock all findings" + "3 of 12 findings locked" + Upgrade button

**shadcn components:** Card, Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent, Badge, Button, Progress, Separator, Tooltip

---

## Phase 4: Pricing Page

**File:** `src/pages/Pricing.tsx` (replace)

**Layout:**
1. Header — "Simple, transparent pricing" + Monthly/Annual toggle (Switch + "Save 20%" badge)
2. 3 Pricing Cards (`grid-cols-3`):
   - Free ($0) — basic
   - Pro ($49/mo) — "MOST POPULAR" badge, ring-2 ring-primary, scale-105
   - Agency ($199/mo) — "For teams"
   - Each: 48px price, feature list with Check/X icons, CTA button
3. FAQ — Accordion with 5-6 questions

**shadcn components:** Card, Button, Badge, Switch, Separator, Accordion

---

## Phase 5: Public Landing Page

**File:** `src/pages/Landing.tsx` (new, rendered at `/` outside AppLayout)
**Section components:** `src/components/landing/` (8 files)

**Sections:**
1. LandingNav — sticky, logo + links + "Get Started Free" button
2. HeroSection — "Your Website Is Losing Visitors. We'll Tell You Exactly Why." + inline UrlInput + "No signup required" text
3. SocialProof — company logos + stats (50K+ pages scanned, 4.9 rating, 12% avg lift)
4. HowItWorks — 3 steps: Enter URL → AI Analyzes → Get Fixes (horizontal with connecting lines)
5. FeaturesGrid — 6 cards in 3x2 grid (7 CRO pillars as features)
6. ScorePreview — mock audit report card with blurred suggestions
7. FinalCta — dark bg section with UrlInput + "Join 2,000+ marketers"
8. LandingFooter — links, copyright, social icons

**Route update in App.tsx:** `/` → Landing (public, no sidebar)

---

## Phase 6: My Reports Page

**File:** `src/pages/Reports.tsx` (replace)

**Layout:**
1. PageHeader + "New Scan" button
2. Filter bar — search, status select, score range select, sort select
3. Report Cards Grid (`grid-cols-3`) — each card: URL + favicon, ScoreRing (80px), stats, date, status badge, 3-dot dropdown (View, Re-scan, Delete)
4. Empty State when no scans

**shadcn components:** Card, Input, Select, Badge, DropdownMenu, Skeleton

---

## Phase 7: Settings Page

**File:** `src/pages/Settings.tsx` (replace)

**Tabs:** Profile, Billing, Notifications, API Keys
- Profile: avatar + form fields (name, email, company, website) + Save
- Billing: current plan card + usage Progress bar + billing history Table
- Notifications: 4 toggle Switches
- API Keys: PremiumLock overlay ("Available on Agency plan")

**shadcn components:** Tabs, Card, Input, Label, Button, Avatar, Switch, Progress, Table, Badge

---

## Phase 8: Integrations Page

**File:** `src/pages/Integrations.tsx` (replace)

4 integration cards (`grid-cols-2`): Google Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Search Console — all with "Coming Soon" badges and disabled switches

---

## Phase 9: Auth Pages + Route Protection

**Files:** `src/pages/Login.tsx`, `src/pages/Signup.tsx`, `src/hooks/use-auth.ts`, `src/components/shared/AuthLayout.tsx`, `src/components/shared/ProtectedRoute.tsx`

- AuthLayout: split-screen (form left, testimonial on dark panel right)
- Login: Google OAuth button + email/password + forgot password
- Signup: Google button + name/email/password + terms link
- Mock auth with React Context + localStorage
- ProtectedRoute wraps AppLayout, redirects to /login if unauthenticated

**Route restructure in App.tsx:**
```
/ → Landing (public)
/login → Login (public)
/signup → Signup (public)
/dashboard → ProtectedRoute → AppLayout → Dashboard
/scan, /reports, etc → ProtectedRoute → AppLayout → ...
```

---

## Phase 10: Polish & Responsive

- Page transitions (fade-in animation wrapper)
- KPI number count-up animation (useCountUp hook)
- Card hover effects (border-primary/30, subtle lift)
- Score ring stroke animation on mount
- Loading skeletons for all pages
- Responsive grids: 4→2→1 cols for KPIs, 3→2→1 for cards, stacked on mobile
- Micro-interactions: button hover scale, tab fade transitions
- Toast notifications via Sonner

---

## Build Order (Dependencies)

```
Phase 0 (Foundation)  ← FIRST, everything depends on this
  ↓
Phase 1 (Dashboard)   ← Core user experience
Phase 2 (Scan)        ← Core feature flow
Phase 3 (Report)      ← Revenue/conversion page
  ↓
Phase 4 (Pricing)     ← Monetization
Phase 5 (Landing)     ← Acquisition
Phase 6 (Reports)     ← Scan history
  ↓
Phase 7 (Settings)    ← Account management
Phase 8 (Integrations)← Simplest page
Phase 9 (Auth)        ← Route protection
Phase 10 (Polish)     ← Final quality pass
```

---

## Critical Files to Modify
- `src/App.tsx` — route restructure (public vs authenticated)
- `src/index.css` — animation keyframes
- `tailwind.config.ts` — animation utilities
- `src/components/AppLayout.tsx` — wrap in ProtectedRoute

## Estimated New/Modified Files: ~40 files

## Verification Plan
1. After each phase: `npm run dev` and visually verify all new pages
2. After Phase 0: shared components render in isolation
3. After Phase 3: full scan flow works (input → progress → report)
4. After Phase 5: landing page renders at `/` without sidebar
5. After Phase 9: auth flow works (login → dashboard, logout → landing)
6. After Phase 10: all pages responsive, animations smooth, no layout breaks
7. Final: `npm run build` succeeds with no TypeScript errors

# CROBOT — Production-Grade UI/UX Build Plan

## Context

CROBOT is an AI-powered CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) audit tool. Users paste a URL and get an instant analysis of what's hurting their conversions with AI-generated suggestions. The current codebase has only the app shell built (~15-20% complete) — a dark sidebar, top bar, and placeholder pages. We need to build out all pages to production-grade quality matching Hotjar/Linear/Vercel, applying marketing psychology (urgency, social proof, premium feel, blurred premium content as upgrade triggers).

**Stack:** React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui (49 components ready) + React Router v6 + Recharts + React Hook Form + Zod + Lucide Icons

---

## Phase 0: Foundation Layer (Build First — Everything Depends on This)

### 0A. New File Structure
```
src/
  types/index.ts           — TypeScript interfaces (Scan, Finding, PillarResult, etc.)
  lib/constants.ts         — CRO pillars, score thresholds, pricing tiers, scan steps
  lib/score-utils.ts       — getScoreColor(), getScoreLabel(), getSeverityColor()
  lib/mock-data.ts         — Realistic mock data for all pages
  hooks/use-count-up.ts    — Animated number counter for KPI cards
  hooks/use-auth.ts        — Mock auth context (React Context + localStorage)
  components/shared/       — Reusable CROBOT-specific components:
    ScoreRing.tsx           — SVG circular progress (score-colored, animated)
    KpiCard.tsx             — 48px bold number + label + trend indicator
    SeverityBadge.tsx       — Critical/Warning/Info colored badges
    PillarProgressBar.tsx   — Horizontal bar with pillar label + score
    UrlInput.tsx            — 48px tall URL input + page type select + CTA button
    EmptyState.tsx          — Icon + title + description + CTA
    PremiumLock.tsx         — Blurred overlay with lock icon + "Upgrade" CTA
    PageHeader.tsx          — Page title (28px bold) + description + action button
    ScanProgressTimeline.tsx — Vertical 7-step animated timeline
    BrowserFrame.tsx        — Fake browser chrome for screenshot display
    FindingCard.tsx         — Individual audit finding with severity + recommendation
    PageTransition.tsx      — Fade-in animation wrapper
    AuthLayout.tsx          — Split-screen layout for login/signup
    ProtectedRoute.tsx      — Auth check wrapper
  components/landing/      — Landing page section components (8 files)
```

### 0B. Key Types (`src/types/index.ts`)
- `UserProfile` (id, email, full_name, plan, scans_used, scan_limit)
- `Scan` (id, url, page_type, status, overall_score, issues_found, timestamps)
- `CroPillar` union type (7 pillars)
- `Finding` (title, severity, current_state, recommendation, ai_suggestion, is_premium)
- `PillarResult` (scan_id, pillar, score, findings[])
- `PricingTier` (name, prices, features, highlighted)

### 0C. Constants (`src/lib/constants.ts`)
- `CRO_PILLARS` — 7 pillars with key, label, icon, description
- `SCORE_THRESHOLDS` — { poor: 40, average: 70 }
- `PRICING_TIERS` — Free/Pro/Agency data
- `SCAN_STEPS` — 7 analysis step labels
- `PLAN_LIMITS` — { free: 3, pro: 50, agency: 500 }

### 0D. Score Utils (`src/lib/score-utils.ts`)
- `getScoreColor(score)` → red (<40), amber (40-70), green (70+)
- `getScoreLabel(score)` → "Poor" / "Needs Work" / "Good" / "Excellent"
- `getSeverityColor(severity)` → red/amber/blue classes

### 0E. Mock Data (`src/lib/mock-data.ts`)
- 8-10 realistic scans with varied scores (35-92)
- Full pillar results for 3 scans with 3-5 findings each
- Dashboard stats aggregated from mock scans

### 0F. Animations (add to `index.css` + `tailwind.config.ts`)
- `fade-in` — opacity + translateY
- `scale-in` — scale + fade for cards
- `slide-up` — staggered list items
- `pulse-ring` — scan progress active indicator

### 0G. Shared Components (see descriptions above)
Most critical: **ScoreRing** (SVG circle, animated stroke-dashoffset) and **PremiumLock** (backdrop-blur overlay, key monetization UX)

**Files to modify:** `src/index.css`, `tailwind.config.ts`

---

## Phase 1: Dashboard Page

**File:** `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` (replace existing)

**Layout (top to bottom):**
1. PageHeader — "Welcome back!" + subtitle
2. 4 KPI Cards (`grid-cols-4`): Total Scans, Avg CRO Score, Issues Found, Est. Revenue Impact — each with 48px bold number, trend arrow, colored icon
3. Two-column grid:
   - Left (2/3): Recent Scans table (URL + favicon, ScoreRing mini, issues count, status badge, date) — 5 rows
   - Right (1/3): Quick Scan card with UrlInput + Score Distribution bar chart (Recharts BarChart)

**shadcn components:** Card, Table, Badge, Button, Input, Select, Skeleton

---

## Phase 2: New Scan Page

**File:** `src/pages/Scan.tsx` (replace existing)

**Two states:**

**State A — URL Input Form:**
- Centered card (max-w-2xl), UrlInput (48px), page type dropdown, "Start Analysis" full-width button
- Below: 7 small pillar cards showing what gets analyzed
- Usage indicator: "2/3 free scans used" progress bar

**State B — Analysis Progress (after submit):**
- Browser frame mockup showing URL being scanned
- ScanProgressTimeline: 7 steps animating sequentially (~8 seconds total)
- Each step: pending (gray) → active (indigo pulse) → complete (green check)
- Overall Progress bar at top
- Auto-redirect to `/reports/:id` on completion

**shadcn components:** Card, Input, Button, Select, Progress, Badge

---

## Phase 3: Audit Report Page (The "Money Page")

**File:** `src/pages/AuditReport.tsx` (new)
**Route:** `/reports/:id` → AuditReport

**Layout:**
1. Report Header — URL + page type + date + status | Download PDF, Share, Re-scan buttons
2. Score Overview (`grid-cols-3`):
   - Left: Giant ScoreRing (200px, 64px number)
   - Right: 7 PillarProgressBars sorted worst-first
3. Page Screenshot — BrowserFrame with placeholder + floating issue badges
4. Detailed Findings — Tabs (7 tabs, one per pillar):
   - Each tab: list of FindingCards
   - FindingCard: colored left border, severity badge, current state, recommendation, AI suggestion
   - Premium findings: wrapped in PremiumLock (blurred + "Upgrade to Pro")
   - Show 2-3 unlocked, blur the rest → creates upgrade desire
5. Bottom CTA — "Unlock all findings" + "3 of 12 findings locked" + Upgrade button

**shadcn components:** Card, Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent, Badge, Button, Progress, Separator, Tooltip

---

## Phase 4: Pricing Page

**File:** `src/pages/Pricing.tsx` (replace)

**Layout:**
1. Header — "Simple, transparent pricing" + Monthly/Annual toggle (Switch + "Save 20%" badge)
2. 3 Pricing Cards (`grid-cols-3`):
   - Free ($0) — basic
   - Pro ($49/mo) — "MOST POPULAR" badge, ring-2 ring-primary, scale-105
   - Agency ($199/mo) — "For teams"
   - Each: 48px price, feature list with Check/X icons, CTA button
3. FAQ — Accordion with 5-6 questions

**shadcn components:** Card, Button, Badge, Switch, Separator, Accordion

---

## Phase 5: Public Landing Page

**File:** `src/pages/Landing.tsx` (new, rendered at `/` outside AppLayout)
**Section components:** `src/components/landing/` (8 files)

**Sections:**
1. LandingNav — sticky, logo + links + "Get Started Free" button
2. HeroSection — "Your Website Is Losing Visitors. We'll Tell You Exactly Why." + inline UrlInput + "No signup required" text
3. SocialProof — company logos + stats (50K+ pages scanned, 4.9 rating, 12% avg lift)
4. HowItWorks — 3 steps: Enter URL → AI Analyzes → Get Fixes (horizontal with connecting lines)
5. FeaturesGrid — 6 cards in 3x2 grid (7 CRO pillars as features)
6. ScorePreview — mock audit report card with blurred suggestions
7. FinalCta — dark bg section with UrlInput + "Join 2,000+ marketers"
8. LandingFooter — links, copyright, social icons

**Route update in App.tsx:** `/` → Landing (public, no sidebar)

---

## Phase 6: My Reports Page

**File:** `src/pages/Reports.tsx` (replace)

**Layout:**
1. PageHeader + "New Scan" button
2. Filter bar — search, status select, score range select, sort select
3. Report Cards Grid (`grid-cols-3`) — each card: URL + favicon, ScoreRing (80px), stats, date, status badge, 3-dot dropdown (View, Re-scan, Delete)
4. Empty State when no scans

**shadcn components:** Card, Input, Select, Badge, DropdownMenu, Skeleton

---

## Phase 7: Settings Page

**File:** `src/pages/Settings.tsx` (replace)

**Tabs:** Profile, Billing, Notifications, API Keys
- Profile: avatar + form fields (name, email, company, website) + Save
- Billing: current plan card + usage Progress bar + billing history Table
- Notifications: 4 toggle Switches
- API Keys: PremiumLock overlay ("Available on Agency plan")

**shadcn components:** Tabs, Card, Input, Label, Button, Avatar, Switch, Progress, Table, Badge

---

## Phase 8: Integrations Page

**File:** `src/pages/Integrations.tsx` (replace)

4 integration cards (`grid-cols-2`): Google Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Search Console — all with "Coming Soon" badges and disabled switches

---

## Phase 9: Auth Pages + Route Protection

**Files:** `src/pages/Login.tsx`, `src/pages/Signup.tsx`, `src/hooks/use-auth.ts`, `src/components/shared/AuthLayout.tsx`, `src/components/shared/ProtectedRoute.tsx`

- AuthLayout: split-screen (form left, testimonial on dark panel right)
- Login: Google OAuth button + email/password + forgot password
- Signup: Google button + name/email/password + terms link
- Mock auth with React Context + localStorage
- ProtectedRoute wraps AppLayout, redirects to /login if unauthenticated

**Route restructure in App.tsx:**
```
/ → Landing (public)
/login → Login (public)
/signup → Signup (public)
/dashboard → ProtectedRoute → AppLayout → Dashboard
/scan, /reports, etc → ProtectedRoute → AppLayout → ...
```

- Page transitions (fade-in animation wrapper)
- KPI number count-up animation (useCountUp hook)
- Card hover effects (border-primary/30, subtle lift)
- Score ring stroke animation on mount
- Loading skeletons for all pages

content.text:
All phases complete! The dev server is running. Here's a summary of everything built:

## Build Complete — CROBOT Production UI

**40+ files created/modified** across all 10 phases. The build compiles cleanly.

### What's Built

| Page | Route | Key Features |
|------|-------|-------------|
| **Landing** | `/` | Hero with dual headline, inline URL input, social proof stats, 3-step how-it-works, 6-card features grid, score preview mockup, testimonials, dark CTA section, footer |
| **Login** | `/login` | Split-screen layout, Google OAuth button, email/password, testimonial dark panel |
| **Signup** | `/signup` | Same split-screen, name/email/password, terms link |
| **Dashboard** | `/dashboard` | 4 animated KPI cards (count-up), recent scans table with mini ScoreRings, score distribution bar chart, quick scan card |
| **New Scan** | `/scan` | URL input with page type selector, 7-step animated progress timeline, browser frame mockup, auto-redirect to report |
| **Audit Report** | `/reports/:id` | 200px ScoreRing, 7 pillar progress bars, browser frame screenshot, key issues sidebar, tabbed findings with FindingCards, blurred PremiumLock on paid findings, bottom upgrade CTA |
| **My Reports** | `/reports` | 3-column card grid, search + 3 filter dropdowns, ScoreRing per card, dropdown menu, empty state |
| **Pricing** | `/pricing` | Monthly/Annual toggle, 3-tier cards (Pro highlighted with scale + ring), feature checklist, FAQ accordion |
| **Settings** | `/settings` | 4 tabs (Profile, Billing, Notifications, API Keys), avatar, form fields, usage bar, toggle switches, PremiumLock on API tab |
| **Integrations** | `/integrations` | 4 integration cards (GA, Hotjar, Clarity, GSC), "Coming Soon" badges, disabled switches |

### Shared Components Built
`ScoreRing`, `KpiCard`, `SeverityBadge`, `PillarProgressBar`, `UrlInput`, `EmptyState`, `PremiumLock`, `PageHeader`, `ScanProgressTimeline`, `BrowserFrame`, `FindingCard`, `PageTransition`

### Foundation Layer
- TypeScript types for all entities
- Constants for CRO pillars, pricing tiers, scan steps
- Score utilities (color coding, labels)
- Realistic mock data (8 scans, 16 findings across 7 pillars)
- Custom animations (fade-in, scale-in, slide-up, pulse-ring)
- `useCountUp` hook for animated KPI numbers

The app is running at **http://localhost:8080**. Navigate to different pages to see the full UI.

- Line 286-288: Final CTA has duplicate UrlInput component with same messaging as earlier section - repetitive copy pattern typical of AI generation

**Generic layouts:**
- Three-step process (line 34-38) is extremely generic SaaS pattern with no differentiator
- Feature cards (line 25-32) use buzzwords without specifics: "AI-Powered", "Competitor Comparison", "Monthly Monitoring" - no technical depth or implementation hints

---

#### **2. Dashboard.tsx** (MODERATE - Mock Data Issues)
**Hardcoded placeholder text:**
- Line 205: "~30 seconds", "7 pillars", "AI suggestions" - These are feature tags but feel placeholder-like, stored as inline hardcoded strings rather than constants

- Line 186: "View" button on recent scans table - no hover states, no loading states for navigation
- No real-time scan status updates (no WebSocket hints, no polling mechanism)
- Recent scans table shows 5 hardcoded results with no pagination controls

- No export functionality (no CSV, no scheduled reports)
- No team collaboration features (no sharing, no comments)
- No anomaly detection alerts (e.g., "Score dropped 10 points since last week")

---

- Line 57: Hardcoded navigation to "/reports/scan_001" - not dynamic based on actual scan ID
- No URL validation beyond `required` attribute (no checking if URL is actually reachable)
- Line 161-167: Usage indicator shows "X/Y scans used" but no real backend context (free plan limits, throttling, rate limiting)
- No retry logic for failed scans

**Design issues:**
- Line 92-96: BrowserFrame shows placeholder gradient instead of actual page screenshot or video
- No visual feedback for slow URLs

- Line 160: Hostname extraction for cards works but shows no real branding/favicon integration
- Filters are purely client-side with no server persistence

---

**Fake FAQ:**
- Lines 18-39: FAQ answers are extremely generic boilerplate:
  - "14-day free trial. No credit card required"
  - "30-day money-back guarantee"
  - "GDPR compliant"
  These are copy-pasted from every SaaS landing page with no company-specific details

**Missing features:**
- No actual payment integration hints (no Stripe, no LemonSqueezy references)
- No seat/user management for team plans
- Pricing tiers don't mention actual technical limits (API calls, concurrent scans, page scan depth)

---

#### **7. Settings.tsx** (GOOD - Realistic)
**Minor issues:**
- Line 143: Hardcoded reset date "April 1, 2026" - Should be dynamic based on billing cycle
- Line 203: Fake API key "sk-crobot-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx" - placeholder never replaced
- Avatar upload (line 85-87) shows hover overlay but no actual upload handler

---

#### **8. Integrations.tsx** (WORST - All Disabled)
**Critical issue:**
- Lines 87-89, 113: Every integration shows "Coming Soon" badge and disabled state. This page is a pure mockup with no actual connector code
- No authentication flow hints (no OAuth callback URLs, no API key management)
- No test connection button
- Benefits list (lines 21-26, 32-37) are descriptive but unverifiable

---

#### **9. Login/Signup.tsx** (MODERATE)
**Fake testimonial:**

- No password strength indicator

- Simple, reusable

- Generic but functional

#### **AppLayout.tsx** (GOOD)
- Clean structure

#### **AppSidebar.tsx** (MODERATE)
- Line 20: "New Scan" has `highlight: true` - probably marketing-driven but feels presumptuous
- No real user data context (no plan badge, no usage indicator)

#### **TopBar.tsx** (GOOD)
- Simple, but hardcoded pageTitles object (line 5-12) means new pages require manual entry

#### **index.css + tailwind.config.ts** (GOOD)
- Well-structured design tokens
- Only issue: Colors chosen seem arbitrary without documented reasoning (why that specific indigo primary?)

---

### **SUMMARY: Top 10 "AI-Generated" Red Flags**

1. **"Screenshot capture available in production"** comment (AuditReport.tsx:164) - Admission the mockup isn't real
2. **Hardcoded testimonials with fake names** (Landing.tsx) - No real customer data
3. **All integrations marked "Coming Soon"** (Integrations.tsx) - Pure mockup, no actual code
4. **Hardcoded navigation ID "/reports/scan_001"** (Scan.tsx:57) - Not dynamic
5. **Generic FAQ copied from every SaaS** (Pricing.tsx:18-39) - No differentiation
6. **Fake social proof stats** (Landing.tsx:104-106) - Unverifiable claims
7. **Email/password auth with 0 actual validation** (Login/Signup) - Just mocks navigation
8. **API key placeholder never replaced** (Settings.tsx:203) - Shows incomplete dev
9. **BrowserFrame always shows placeholder** (BrowserFrame.tsx) - Never displays real content
10. **No real error handling or edge cases** - All components assume happy path (no network errors, no rate limits, no 500 errors)

This is clearly a well-structured React mockup/prototype but needs significant backend integration, real data binding, and production-hardening before launch.

| Notification toggles not persisted | Settings | Saves to localStorage |
| Password change button | Settings | Expands to inline form |

### Medium — Missing validation/feedback:
| Issue | Page | Fix |
|-------|------|-----|
| Login with empty/invalid fields | Login | Email format + password length validation + error banner |
| Signup with empty/invalid fields | Signup | Name required + email format + 8-char password + error banner |
| UrlInput doesn't normalize URLs | UrlInput | Auto-prepends `https://` if missing |
| Notification bell does nothing | TopBar | Opens dropdown with 2 mock notifications + settings link |
